description: Parse the generated 1, 10 and 100 MB documents (bench/gen, seed 20261007). Cold: parse and write Canonical XML 1.0 to a file (go-xml via benchrun -helper, xmllint --c14n), so the outputs can be checked against each other; encoding/xml re-emits RawToken tokens. Warm (in-process engines only): go-xml builds the xdm tree, encoding/xml tokenises with RawToken and re-emits to a null sink. Throughput = file size / median.
